<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#ffd6e5">
<title>Selamat Hari Guru Nasional 2026</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,700;0,800;1,600&family=Quicksand:wght@500;600;700&family=Dancing+Script:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--pink:#d81b60;--pink2:#f0457f;--soft:#ffe3ee;--ink:#7a3050;--muted:#9a5b75}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{min-height:100%}
body{font-family:'Quicksand',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffeaf2 0%,#ffd0e1 100%) fixed;overflow-x:hidden}
.script{font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive}
h2.title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:800;color:var(--pink);font-size:clamp(26px,7.5vw,34px);line-height:1.15}
.sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:8px auto 14px;max-width:320px}
.kicker{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--pink);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}

/* hati melayang di latar */
#hearts{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.hh{position:absolute;bottom:-40px;color:#ff6f9f;opacity:.35;animation:hup linear infinite}
@keyframes hup{from{transform:translateY(0) translateX(0) rotate(-10deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-55vh) translateX(18px) rotate(10deg)}to{transform:translateY(-115vh) translateX(-10px) rotate(-10deg)}}

/* layar */
.screen{display:none;position:relative;z-index:1;min-height:100vh;min-height:100svh;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:26px 20px;text-align:center}
.screen.on{display:flex;animation:sIn .6s ease both}
@keyframes sIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.btn{font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink2),var(--pink));border:0;border-radius:99px;padding:12px 26px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(216,27,96,.35);transition:transform .2s}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.btn.sm{padding:8px 18px;font-size:12px}
.btn.hide{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(8px)}
.btn.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none;transition:opacity .6s,transform .6s}
.link{background:none;border:0;font:inherit;font-size:13px;color:var(--pink);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;margin-top:14px;text-decoration:underline}

/* ===== AMPLOP ===== */
.envw{position:relative;width:270px;margin:0 auto;cursor:pointer}
.envb{position:relative;width:270px;height:170px;margin-top:190px;perspective:900px}
.envb .back{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#f6a3c0;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 20px 34px rgba(216,27,96,.28)}
.pcard{position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;height:215px;z-index:2;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.12);transform-origin:bottom center;transform:scale(.72);transition:transform 1s cubic-bezier(.3,1.2,.4,1) .45s;cursor:default}
.envw.open .pcard{transform:translateY(-128px) scale(1)}
.envw.pop .pcard{z-index:6}
.pcard .pe{font-size:26px;line-height:1}
.pcard .a1{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:700;color:var(--pink);font-size:16px;margin-top:6px}
.pcard .a2{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:600;color:#c2185b;font-size:18px;word-break:break-word}
.pcard .pp{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin:8px 0 10px;line-height:1.5}
.envb .pl,.envb .pr,.envb .pb{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:3;pointer-events:none}
.envb .pl{background:#f9b6cd;clip-path:polygon(0 0,52% 56%,0 100%)}
.envb .pr{background:#f9b6cd;clip-path:polygon(100% 0,48% 56%,100% 100%)}
.envb .pb{background:#fcd0e0;clip-path:polygon(0 100%,50% 44%,100% 100%)}
.envb .flap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:60%;z-index:4;background:#f48fb1;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,50% 100%);transform-origin:top center;transition:transform .7s ease,z-index 0s .35s}
.envw.open .flap{transform:rotateX(180deg);z-index:1}
.envb .seal{position:absolute;left:50%;top:60%;width:44px;height:44px;margin:-22px 0 0 -22px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#ff5d86,#c4143f);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#ffd54f;font-size:20px;z-index:5;box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s;animation:beat 1.5s infinite}
.envw.open .seal{opacity:0;transform:scale(.3);animation:none}
@keyframes beat{50%{transform:scale(1.12)}}
.envw:not(.open) .envb{animation:bob 3s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
.hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--pink);margin-top:20px;font-weight:600}

/* ===== BUKU ===== */
.bookwrap{position:relative;width:min(290px,80vw);height:370px;margin:10px auto 0;perspective:1200px}
.page{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#fffdf8;border-radius:6px 14px 14px 6px;padding:20px 18px 16px 24px;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(216,27,96,.25);overflow:hidden;
  background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(transparent 0 27px,#f5e4ea 27px 28px)}
.page .hi{font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive;font-weight:700;color:var(--pink);font-size:25px;line-height:1.1;word-break:break-word}
.page .body{font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive;font-weight:600;font-size:19px;line-height:28px;margin-top:10px;white-space:pre-line;color:#3d2a33}
.page .sig{font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive;font-weight:700;font-size:19px;text-align:right;margin-top:8px;color:var(--pink)}
.w{display:inline-block;opacity:0;animation:wIn .5s ease forwards}
@keyframes wIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.cover{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:6px 14px 14px 6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ee2a6f,#b3124f);transform-origin:left center;transition:transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.2,1);backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:6px 12px 26px rgba(179,18,79,.4),inset 6px 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,.18);color:#fff}
.cover:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:14px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,214,225,.6);border-radius:8px}
.cover .ct{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:20px;line-height:1.25;padding:0 28px}
.cover .lk{font-size:38px;margin:14px 0 18px;display:block}
.cover .tp{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:700;opacity:.85}
.bookwrap.open .cover{transform:rotateY(-168deg);pointer-events:none}
.bookwrap.unl .lk{animation:shake .5s}
@keyframes shake{20%,60%{transform:rotate(-14deg)}40%,80%{transform:rotate(14deg)}}
.bookwrap:not(.open) .cover{animation:bob2 3s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes bob2{50%{transform:translateY(-6px)}}
.editbox{display:none;width:min(320px,86vw);background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;margin-top:12px;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(216,27,96,.15)}
.editbox.on{display:grid;gap:10px}
label{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
input,textarea{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:14px;padding:10px 12px;border:1.5px solid #f3cadb;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);margin-top:3px}
input:focus,textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--pink2);border-color:var(--pink2)}

/* ===== FOTO ===== */
.stack{position:relative;width:min(300px,80vw);height:268px;margin:6px auto 0;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.pc{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;background:#fff;padding:10px 10px 0;height:240px;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(120,20,60,.25);transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2,1,.4,1),opacity .4s;cursor:grab;transform-origin:center bottom}
.pc .ph{aspect-ratio:16/9;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd3e3,#ffb3cf);display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;color:#b5476f;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none}
.pc .ph img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.pc .ph svg{width:30px;height:30px;display:block;margin:0 auto 4px;opacity:.7}
.pc .cap{font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive;font-weight:700;font-size:22px;color:#444;margin-top:12px;pointer-events:none}
.cnt{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0 14px}
#lb{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(70,10,40,.92);display:none;place-items:center;z-index:80;padding:20px;overflow:hidden}
#lb.on{display:grid}
#lb figure{position:relative;max-width:min(92vw,560px);text-align:center}
#lb.on figure{animation:zoom .55s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.4,1)}
@keyframes zoom{from{transform:scale(.4) rotate(-8deg);opacity:0}}
#lb img{max-width:100%;max-height:70vh;border:10px solid #fff;border-bottom-width:40px;border-radius:3px}
#lb figcaption{font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive;font-weight:700;font-size:26px;color:#fff;margin-top:-34px;position:relative}
.stk{position:absolute;font-size:40px;line-height:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.4));animation:stkPop .6s cubic-bezier(.2,1.8,.4,1) both,wob 2.2s ease-in-out .7s infinite}
@keyframes stkPop{from{transform:scale(0) rotate(-40deg);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1) rotate(0);opacity:1}}
@keyframes wob{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-12deg)}50%{transform:rotate(12deg) scale(1.12)}}
.bub2{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-40px;background:#ffd54f;color:#6a2340;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;padding:7px 15px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.35);animation:bubPop .6s .3s cubic-bezier(.2,1.8,.4,1) both}
@keyframes bubPop{from{transform:translateX(-50%) scale(0);opacity:0}to{transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1);opacity:1}}
.lbe{position:absolute;bottom:-50px;pointer-events:none;animation:rise2 linear forwards}
@keyframes rise2{to{transform:translateY(-115vh) rotate(var(--rot,200deg))}}

/* ===== KUE ===== */
.cakebox{position:relative;width:min(300px,82vw);height:240px;margin:4px auto 0;touch-action:none;cursor:grab}
.cakew{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:0;width:240px;height:210px;margin-left:-120px}
.half{position:absolute;inset:0;transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.4,1)}
.half.l{clip-path:inset(0 50% 0 0)}
.half.r{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 50%)}
.cut .half.l{transform:translateX(-14px) rotate(-3deg)}
.cut .half.r{transform:translateX(14px) rotate(3deg)}
.t{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:10px 10px 6px 6px;background:linear-gradient(#ff8fb4,#ee5a8c)}
.t:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:10px;background:#fff;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0}
.t:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:10px;left:0;right:0;height:12px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 10px 0,#fff 9px,transparent 10px) 0 0/20px 100% repeat-x}
.t1{bottom:14px;width:210px;height:66px}
.t2{bottom:78px;width:150px;height:54px}
.t3{bottom:130px;width:96px;height:44px}
.plate{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:0;width:240px;height:16px;margin-left:-120px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(216,27,96,.25)}
.candle{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:172px;width:8px;height:34px;margin-left:-4px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#fff 0 6px,#ff5c8d 6px 12px);border-radius:3px}
.flame{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-20px;width:12px;height:18px;margin-left:-6px;background:radial-gradient(#fff6c0,#ffb300 70%);border-radius:50% 50% 50% 50%/60% 60% 40% 40%;animation:flick .3s infinite alternate;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px #ffb300)}
@keyframes flick{to{transform:scale(1.1,.9) rotate(5deg)}}
.out .flame{display:none}
.knife{position:absolute;top:0;left:6%;font-size:34px;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);pointer-events:none;transition:left .35s,opacity .4s;z-index:5;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.25))}
.cutline{position:absolute;left:50%;top:30px;bottom:14px;width:3px;margin-left:-1.5px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 12px #fff;opacity:0;z-index:4}
.cut ~ .cutline,.cakebox.fl .cutline{animation:flash .7s ease}
@keyframes flash{0%{opacity:0}30%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
.pill{display:inline-block;border:1.5px dashed rgba(216,27,96,.5);color:var(--pink);background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 16px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin:10px 0 16px}

/* ===== GELEMBUNG ===== */
.bbox{position:relative;width:min(320px,86vw);height:250px;border:1.5px dashed rgba(216,27,96,.3);border-radius:22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);overflow:hidden;margin:0 auto}
.bub{position:absolute;width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;color:#a8305f;text-align:center;padding:10px;cursor:pointer;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 25%,rgba(255,255,255,.98),rgba(255,255,255,.4) 35%,rgba(255,170,205,.35) 70%,rgba(255,255,255,.75));border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);box-shadow:inset -6px -8px 14px rgba(255,120,170,.25),0 6px 16px rgba(216,27,96,.2);animation:bfloat var(--t) ease-in-out infinite alternate;transition:transform .3s,opacity .3s}
@keyframes bfloat{from{transform:translate(0,0)}to{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy))}}
.bub.pop{transform:scale(1.7)!important;opacity:0;animation:none}
.wcard{width:min(320px,86vw);margin:14px auto 0;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 16px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(216,27,96,.15);min-height:100px}
.wcard .em{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:6px}
.wcard .tx{font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive;font-weight:700;font-size:20px;color:#4a2b38;line-height:1.3;margin-top:4px}
.wcard .tx.f{animation:wIn .5s both}
.big{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:700;color:var(--pink);font-size:20px;margin-top:16px}
.tiny{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0 14px}

/* ===== KADO ===== */
.gift{position:relative;width:150px;height:150px;margin:36px auto 30px;cursor:pointer;animation:gb 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes gb{50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
.gift.shake{animation:gs .7s}
@keyframes gs{20%{transform:rotate(-8deg)}40%{transform:rotate(8deg)}60%{transform:rotate(-6deg)}80%{transform:rotate(6deg)}}
.gbox{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:10px;right:10px;height:86px;background:#d4152a;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 14px 24px rgba(180,10,40,.35)}
.gbox:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:50%;width:22px;margin-left:-11px;background:#f6c026}
.glid{position:absolute;bottom:80px;left:0;right:0;height:38px;background:#e02032;border-radius:4px;transform-origin:left bottom;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.4,1)}
.glid:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:50%;width:22px;margin-left:-11px;background:#f6c026}
.glid:after{content:"🎀";position:absolute;top:-24px;left:50%;margin-left:-16px;font-size:30px}
.gift.open .glid{transform:translate(-8px,-58px) rotate(-22deg)}
.gift.open{animation:none}
.gtag{position:absolute;top:-22px;left:-26px;background:#ffe27a;color:#6a2340;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:5px;transform:rotate(-12deg);box-shadow:0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.2);z-index:3}
.gsurp{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:60px;font-size:40px;margin-left:-20px;opacity:0;transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.2,1.2,.4,1),opacity .4s}
.gift.open .gsurp{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-90px) scale(1.2)}

/* burst */
.bst{position:fixed;font-size:20px;z-index:90;pointer-events:none;animation:burst 1.2s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes burst{from{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.6);opacity:1}to{transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--dx)),calc(-50% + var(--dy))) scale(1.1);opacity:0}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation-duration:.01s!important;transition-duration:.01s!important}.hh{display:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="hearts"></div>

<!-- 1. AMPLOP -->
<section class="screen on" id="s1">
  <div class="kicker">Selamat Hari Guru Nasional · 25 November 2026</div>
  <div class="envw" id="env1"></div>
  <p class="hint" id="hint1" data-h="Tekan amplop untuk membuka surat ✨">Tekan amplop untuk membuka surat ✨</p>
</section>

<!-- 2. BUKU HARIAN -->
<section class="screen" id="s2">
  <h2 class="title">Buku Harian Murid</h2>
  <p class="sub">Ketuk buku untuk memutar kuncinya &amp; membacanya</p>
  <div class="bookwrap" id="book">
    <div class="page">
      <div class="hi" id="outHi">Teruntuk Bu Maria,</div>
      <div class="body" id="outMsg"></div>
      <div class="sig" id="outFrom">Dari murid-muridmu</div>
    </div>
    <div class="cover" id="cover">
      <div><div class="ct">Buku Harian<br>untuk Guru</div><span class="lk" id="lock">🔒</span><div class="tp">KETUK UNTUK MEMBUKA</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="margin-top:18px"><button class="btn hide" id="toMem" type="button">Lihat Kenangan →</button></div>
  <button class="link" id="editBtn" type="button">✏️ Ubah nama &amp; pesan</button>
  <div class="editbox" id="editBox">
    <div><label for="inTo">Nama guru</label><input id="inTo" placeholder="mis. Ibu Sari" maxlength="40"></div>
    <div><label for="inFrom">Dari</label><input id="inFrom" placeholder="mis. Murid-murid kelas 9A" maxlength="50"></div>
    <div><label for="inMsg">Pesan</label><textarea id="inMsg" rows="5" maxlength="300"></textarea></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 3. FOTO KENANGAN -->
<section class="screen" id="s3">
  <h2 class="title">Kenangan Kita</h2>
  <p class="sub">Tarik &amp; lempar tumpukan foto untuk melihatnya! Ketuk foto untuk memperbesar 📷</p>
  <div class="stack" id="stack"></div>
  <div class="cnt" id="cnt">1 / 9</div>
  <button class="btn" id="toCake" type="button">Waktunya Kue! →</button>
    <input type="file" id="file" accept="image/*" hidden>
  <input type="file" id="fileMany" accept="image/*" multiple hidden>
</section>

<!-- 4. KUE -->
<section class="screen" id="s4">
  <h2 class="title" id="cakeT">Waktunya Kue!</h2>
  <p class="sub" id="cakeS">Geser pisau dari kiri ke kanan untuk memotong kuenya! 🍰</p>
  <div class="cakebox" id="cakebox">
    <div class="cakew" id="cakew"><div class="half l"></div><div class="half r"></div></div>
    <div class="cutline"></div>
    <div class="knife" id="knife">🔪</div>
  </div>
  <div class="pill" id="cakeHint">Geser untuk memotong kue!</div>
  <button class="btn hide" id="toWish" type="button">Buat Harapan →</button>
</section>

<!-- 5. GELEMBUNG HARAPAN -->
<section class="screen" id="s5">
  <h2 class="title">Harapan Melayang</h2>
  <p class="sub">Pecahkan gelembung sabun kaca untuk mengabulkan harapanmu! 🫧</p>
  <div class="bbox" id="bbox"></div>
  <div class="wcard"><div class="em">✨ ❤️ ✨</div><div class="tx" id="wtx">Ketuk gelembung untuk membaca doa dari kami.</div></div>
  <div class="big">Selamat Hari Guru ♥</div>
  <div class="tiny">SELAMANYA DI HATI KAMI</div>
  <button class="btn" id="toGift" type="button">Buka Hadiah →</button>
</section>

<!-- 6. KADO -->
<section class="screen" id="s6">
  <h2 class="title">Satu Hal Lagi…</h2>
  <p class="sub">Ketuk kotak kado untuk membuka hadiah spesialmu! 🎁</p>
  <div class="gift" id="gift">
    <div class="gtag">Untuk Guru ✨</div>
    <div class="gsurp">💌</div>
    <div class="gbox"></div>
    <div class="glid"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 7. AMPLOP PENUTUP -->
<section class="screen" id="s7">
  <div class="kicker">Pesan terakhir</div>
  <div class="envw" id="env2"></div>
  <p class="hint" id="hint2" data-h="Ketuk segel hati untuk membuka pesan terakhir 💌">Ketuk segel hati untuk membuka pesan terakhir 💌</p>
</section>

<div id="lb" role="dialog" aria-label="Foto"><figure><img id="lbImg" alt=""><figcaption id="lbCap"></figcaption></figure></div>

<script>
(function(){
  var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i)};
  function store(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v));return true}catch(e){return false}}
  function load(k,d){try{var s=localStorage.getItem(k);return s?JSON.parse(s):d}catch(e){return d}}
  function rnd(a){return a[Math.floor(Math.random()*a.length)]}

  /* hati melayang */
  (function(){
    var h=$('hearts');
    for(var i=0;i<26;i++){
      var s=document.createElement('span');s.className='hh';s.textContent='♥';
      s.style.left=(Math.random()*96)+'%';s.style.fontSize=(10+Math.random()*20)+'px';
      s.style.animationDuration=(14+Math.random()*18)+'s';s.style.animationDelay=(-Math.random()*30)+'s';
      s.style.opacity=(.18+Math.random()*.3);
      h.appendChild(s);
    }
  })();

  /* ledakan emoji */
  function burst(el,n){
    var r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),cx=r.left+r.width/2,cy=r.top+r.height/2;
    var em=['💖','💗','✨','🍎','📚','🎉','💝'];
    for(var i=0;i<(n||14);i++){
      var s=document.createElement('span');s.className='bst';s.textContent=em[i%em.length];
      var a=Math.random()*6.283,d=60+Math.random()*100;
      s.style.left=cx+'px';s.style.top=cy+'px';
      s.style.setProperty('--dx',Math.cos(a)*d+'px');s.style.setProperty('--dy',(Math.sin(a)*d-30)+'px');
      s.style.animationDuration=(.9+Math.random()*.6)+'s';
      document.body.appendChild(s);
      setTimeout(function(n){n.remove()},1700,s);
    }
  }

  /* navigasi */
  var S=['s1','s2','s3','s4','s5','s6','s7'];
  var resets={};
  function go(id){
    S.forEach(function(v){$(v).classList.toggle('on',v===id)});
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
    if(resets[id])resets[id]();
  }

  /* ===== nama & pesan ===== */
  var DEFMSG='Terima kasih, Bu Maria, sudah sabar mengajar kami, bahkan di hari-hari ketika kami sulit diatur.\n\nIlmu dan nasihat Ibu akan kami bawa ke mana pun melangkah.\n\nSelamat Hari Guru Nasional! ♥';
  var d=load('hg-names2',{to:'',from:'',msg:''});
  function upd(){
    var to=$('inTo').value.trim(),fr=$('inFrom').value.trim();
    var nm=$('nm1');if(nm)nm.textContent=to||'Bu Maria';
    $('outHi').textContent='Teruntuk '+(to||'Bu Maria')+',';
    $('outFrom').textContent='Dari '+(fr||'murid-muridmu');
    $('outMsg').textContent=$('inMsg').value.trim()||DEFMSG;
    var f=$('nm2');if(f)f.textContent='Terima kasih, '+(to||'Bu Maria')+' 💗';
    store('hg-names2',{to:$('inTo').value,from:$('inFrom').value,msg:$('inMsg').value});
  }

  /* ===== amplop (dipakai 2x) ===== */
  function envHTML(card,seal){
    return '<div class="envb"><div class="back"></div><div class="pcard">'+card+'</div><div class="pl"></div><div class="pr"></div><div class="pb"></div><div class="flap"></div>'+(seal?'<div class="seal">♥</div>':'')+'</div>';
  }
  function setupEnv(wid,card,seal,hintId,openHint){
    var w=$(wid),h=$(hintId),opened=false,t;
    w.innerHTML=envHTML(card,seal);
    w.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      if(opened||e.target.closest('button'))return;
      opened=true;w.classList.add('open');burst(w.querySelector('.envb'),12);
      t=setTimeout(function(){w.classList.add('pop');h.textContent=openHint},1500);
    });
    return function(){opened=false;clearTimeout(t);w.classList.remove('open','pop');h.textContent=h.dataset.h};
  }
  resets.s1=setupEnv('env1',
    '<div class="pe">🎈🍎📚</div><div class="a1">Selamat Hari Guru,</div><div class="a2" id="nm1">Bu Maria</div><p class="pp">Ada kejutan kecil dari kami untukmu. Tekan tombol di bawah untuk membukanya.</p><button class="btn sm" id="go2" type="button">Mulai Kejutan →</button>',
    false,'hint1','Terbuka! Tekan tombol di surat… ✨');
  resets.s7=setupEnv('env2',
    '<div class="pe">💌</div><div class="a1" id="nm2">Terima kasih, Bu Maria 💗</div><p class="pp">Ibu bukan hanya mengajar, tapi mengajarkan kami cara bermimpi. Selamat Hari Guru Nasional 2026!</p><button class="btn sm" id="again" type="button">Ulangi dari awal ↺</button>',
    true,'hint2','Dengan cinta, dari murid-muridmu ♥');
  $('go2').addEventListener('click',function(){go('s2')});
  $('again').addEventListener('click',function(){go('s1')});

  $('inTo').value=d.to||'Bu Maria';$('inFrom').value=d.from||'';$('inMsg').value=d.msg||DEFMSG;
  ['inTo','inFrom','inMsg'].forEach(function(i){$(i).addEventListener('input',upd)});
  upd();
  $('editBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){$('editBox').classList.toggle('on')});

  /* ===== buku harian ===== */
  var book=$('book'),bookOpened=false;
  function animMsg(){
    var el=$('outMsg'),t=el.textContent;el.textContent='';var n=0;
    t.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(function(tok){
      if(!tok)return;
      if(/^\s+$/.test(tok)){el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(tok));return}
      var s=document.createElement('span');s.className='w';s.textContent=tok;
      s.style.animationDelay=(1.1+n*0.05)+'s';n++;el.appendChild(s);
    });
  }
  resets.s2=function(){
    bookOpened=false;book.classList.remove('open','unl');$('lock').textContent='🔒';
    $('toMem').className='btn hide';upd();
  };
  $('cover').addEventListener('click',function(){
    if(bookOpened)return;bookOpened=true;
    $('lock').textContent='🔓';book.classList.add('unl');
    setTimeout(function(){
      animMsg();book.classList.add('open');
      setTimeout(function(){$('toMem').className='btn show'},2600);
    },650);
  });
  $('toMem').addEventListener('click',function(){go('s3')});

  /* ===== foto: tumpukan 9 ===== */
  var BASE=[{"src": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cap": "Seru bareng", "pos": "center"}, {"src": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cap": "Depan sekolah", "pos": "center"}, {"src": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cap": "Pagi yang ceria", "pos": "center"}, {"src": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cap": "Pramuka kita", "pos": "center"}, {"src": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cap": "Salam hangat", "pos": "center"}, {"src": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cap": "Mlaku-mlaku", "pos": "center"}, {"src": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cap": "Pramuka ceria", "pos": "center"}, {"src": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cap": "Satu keluarga", "pos": "center 92%"}, {"src": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cap": "Jalan-jalan seru", "pos": "center 100%"}];
  var saved=load('hg-photos-v3',{});
  var photos=[];
  for(var bi=0;bi<9;bi++){
    if(BASE[bi])photos.push(BASE[bi]);
    else photos.push({src:(saved[bi]&&saved[bi].src)||'',cap:'Foto menyusul ✨',pos:'center'});
  }
  var pending=-1;
  function save(){var o={};photos.forEach(function(p,i){if(!BASE[i]&&p.src)o[i]={src:p.src}});store('hg-photos-v3',o)}
  var cam='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M4 8h3l2-2.5h6L17 8h3a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v9a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V9a1 1 0 0 1 1-1z"/><circle cx="12" cy="13" r="3.5"/></svg>';
  function cardInner(p,i){
    return '<div class="ph">'+(p.src?'<img src="'+p.src+'" alt="" style="object-position:'+(p.pos||'center')+'">':'<div>'+cam+'Foto '+(i+1)+'<br>ketuk untuk menambah</div>')+'</div><div class="cap"></div>';
  }
  var stack=$('stack'),cards=[],order=[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8],ROT=[-2,4,-5,6];
  function fillCard(i){
    cards[i].innerHTML=cardInner(photos[i],i);
    cards[i].querySelector('.cap').textContent=photos[i].cap;
  }
  function layout(){
    order.forEach(function(idx,k){
      var c=cards[idx],kk=Math.min(k,3);
      c.style.zIndex=100-k;c.style.opacity=k<4?1:0;
      c.style.transform='translateY('+(kk*8)+'px) rotate('+ROT[kk]+'deg) scale('+(1-kk*.035)+')';
    });
    $('cnt').textContent=(order[0]+1)+' / 9';
  }
  function build(){
    stack.innerHTML='';
    cards=photos.map(function(p,i){var c=document.createElement('div');c.className='pc';stack.appendChild(c);return c});
    photos.forEach(function(p,i){fillCard(i)});
    layout();
  }
  build();
  resets.s3=function(){order=[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8];layout();burst($('stack'),16)};
  var drag=null;
  stack.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
    drag={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,top:cards[order[0]]};
    drag.top.style.transition='none';
    try{stack.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
  });
  stack.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
    if(!drag)return;
    var dx=e.clientX-drag.x,dy=e.clientY-drag.y;
    drag.top.style.transform='translate('+dx+'px,'+dy+'px) rotate('+(dx/14-2)+'deg)';
  });
  function endDrag(e){
    if(!drag)return;
    var top=drag.top,dx=e.clientX-drag.x,dy=e.clientY-drag.y,dist=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    drag=null;top.style.transition='';
    if(dist>70){
      top.style.transform='translate('+(dx*5)+'px,'+(dy*5-80)+'px) rotate('+(dx/3)+'deg)';
      top.style.opacity=0;
      setTimeout(function(){
        top.style.transition='none';order.push(order.shift());layout();
        void top.offsetWidth;top.style.transition='';
      },380);
    }else if(dist<8){
      layout();
      var idx=order[0],p=photos[idx];
      p.src?openLb(p):pick(idx);
    }else{layout()}
  }
  stack.addEventListener('pointerup',endDrag);
  stack.addEventListener('pointercancel',function(){if(drag){drag.top.style.transition='';drag=null;layout()}});
  $('toCake').addEventListener('click',function(){go('s4')});

  function shrink(file,cb){
    var r=new FileReader();
    r.onload=function(){
      var im=new Image();
      im.onload=function(){
        var m=800,s=Math.min(1,m/Math.max(im.width,im.height));
        var c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=Math.round(im.width*s);c.height=Math.round(im.height*s);
        c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im,0,0,c.width,c.height);
        cb(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.72));
      };
      im.src=r.result;
    };
    r.readAsDataURL(file);
  }
  function pick(i){pending=i;$('file').value='';$('file').click()}
  $('file').addEventListener('change',function(){
    var f=this.files[0];if(!f||pending<0)return;var i=pending;
    shrink(f,function(dd){photos[i].src=dd;save();fillCard(i)});
  });
  if($('addMany'))$('addMany').addEventListener('click',function(){$('fileMany').value='';$('fileMany').click()});
  $('fileMany').addEventListener('change',function(){
    Array.prototype.slice.call(this.files).forEach(function(f){
      shrink(f,function(dd){
        var i=-1;photos.forEach(function(p,k){if(i<0&&!p.src)i=k});
        if(i>=0){photos[i].src=dd;save();fillCard(i)}
      });
    });
  });

  /* lightbox + emoji */
  var STK=['👩‍🏫','👨‍🏫','🍎','📚','✏️','🎓','🏫','🌟','💐','🎒','🥳','😍','🥹','❤️','🖍️','🏆'];
  var BUB=['Terima kasih, Guru! 🍎','Guruku pahlawanku! 🦸','Selamat Hari Guru! 🎉','Ilmumu abadi ✨','Kami sayang Bu Maria! 💛'];
  function openLb(p){
    var lb=$('lb'),fig=lb.querySelector('figure');
    Array.prototype.slice.call(lb.querySelectorAll('.stk,.lbe,.bub2')).forEach(function(n){n.remove()});
    $('lbImg').src=p.src;$('lbCap').textContent=p.cap||'';
    lb.classList.remove('on');void lb.offsetWidth;lb.classList.add('on');
    ['top:-22px;left:-18px','top:-22px;right:-18px','bottom:24px;left:-20px','bottom:24px;right:-20px'].forEach(function(ps,i){
      var s=document.createElement('span');s.className='stk';s.textContent=rnd(STK);s.style.cssText=ps;
      s.style.animationDelay=(i*.12)+'s,'+(i*.12+.7)+'s';fig.appendChild(s);
    });
    var b=document.createElement('div');b.className='bub2';b.textContent=rnd(BUB);fig.appendChild(b);
    for(var k=0;k<14;k++){
      var e=document.createElement('span');e.className='lbe';e.textContent=rnd(STK);
      e.style.left=(Math.random()*94)+'%';e.style.fontSize=(24+Math.random()*22)+'px';
      e.style.animationDuration=(3+Math.random()*3)+'s';e.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*1.5)+'s';
      e.style.setProperty('--rot',(Math.random()*400-200)+'deg');
      e.addEventListener('animationend',function(){this.remove()});
      lb.appendChild(e);
    }
  }
  $('lb').addEventListener('click',function(){this.classList.remove('on')});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')$('lb').classList.remove('on')});

  /* ===== kue ===== */
  var cakeHTML='<div class="candle"><i class="flame"></i></div><div class="t t3"></div><div class="t t2"></div><div class="t t1"></div><div class="plate"></div>';
  var cakew=$('cakew'),cakebox=$('cakebox'),knife=$('knife'),cutDone=false,cx0=null;
  cakew.querySelector('.l').innerHTML=cakeHTML;cakew.querySelector('.r').innerHTML=cakeHTML;
  resets.s4=function(){
    cutDone=false;cx0=null;cakew.classList.remove('cut','out');cakebox.classList.remove('fl');
    $('cakeT').textContent='Waktunya Kue!';
    $('cakeS').textContent='Geser pisau dari kiri ke kanan untuk memotong kuenya! 🍰';
    $('cakeHint').style.display='';$('toWish').className='btn hide';
    knife.style.opacity=1;knife.style.transition='left .35s,opacity .4s';knife.style.left='6%';
  };
  function doCut(){
    if(cutDone)return;cutDone=true;
    knife.style.transition='left .3s,opacity .5s .2s';knife.style.left='96%';knife.style.opacity=0;
    cakebox.classList.add('fl');
    setTimeout(function(){cakew.classList.add('cut','out');burst(cakew,18)},250);
    setTimeout(function(){
      $('cakeT').textContent='Yummy! Buat permohonan…';
      $('cakeS').textContent='Lilinnya sudah padam diiup cinta ✨';
      $('cakeHint').style.display='none';$('toWish').className='btn show';
    },900);
  }
  cakebox.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
    if(cutDone)return;cx0=e.clientX;knife.style.transition='opacity .4s';
    try{cakebox.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
  });
  cakebox.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
    if(cx0===null||cutDone)return;
    var r=cakebox.getBoundingClientRect(),p=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100;
    knife.style.left=Math.max(6,Math.min(92,p))+'%';
    if(e.clientX-cx0>r.width*.5)doCut();
  });
  function knifeUp(){if(cutDone)return;cx0=null;knife.style.transition='left .35s,opacity .4s';knife.style.left='6%'}
  cakebox.addEventListener('pointerup',knifeUp);
  cakebox.addEventListener('pointercancel',knifeUp);
  $('toWish').addEventListener('click',function(){go('s5')});

  /* ===== gelembung harapan ===== */
  var WISHES=[
    ['Sehat Selalu','Semoga Ibu selalu diberi kesehatan dan umur yang penuh berkah.'],
    ['Bahagia Terus','Semoga hari-hari Ibu dipenuhi senyum, seperti tawa kami di kelas.'],
    ['Murah Rezeki','Semoga rezeki Ibu mengalir lancar dan berlimpah keberkahan.'],
    ['Dicintai Murid','Semoga Ibu selalu dikenang dan dicintai murid-murid sepanjang masa.'],
    ['Bangga pada Kami','Semoga semua murid tumbuh jadi orang hebat dan membuat Ibu bangga.'],
    ['Pahala Mengalir','Semoga ilmu yang diajarkan menjadi amal jariyah yang tak pernah putus.']
  ];
  var POS=[[5,6],[56,4],[30,36],[62,42],[6,64],[44,68]];
  function spawn(){
    var box=$('bbox');box.innerHTML='';
    $('wtx').textContent='Ketuk gelembung untuk membaca doa dari kami.';
    WISHES.forEach(function(w,i){
      var b=document.createElement('div');b.className='bub';b.textContent=w[0];
      b.style.left=POS[i][0]+'%';b.style.top=POS[i][1]+'%';
      b.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*28-14)+'px');b.style.setProperty('--dy',(Math.random()*28-14)+'px');
      b.style.setProperty('--t',(2.5+Math.random()*2)+'s');
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){
        if(b.classList.contains('pop'))return;
        b.classList.add('pop');burst(b,8);setTimeout(function(){b.remove()},320);
        var t=$('wtx');t.textContent=w[1];t.classList.remove('f');void t.offsetWidth;t.classList.add('f');
      });
      box.appendChild(b);
    });
  }
  resets.s5=spawn;
  $('toGift').addEventListener('click',function(){go('s6')});

  /* ===== kado ===== */
  var gift=$('gift'),gOpened=false;
  resets.s6=function(){gOpened=false;gift.classList.remove('open','shake')};
  gift.addEventListener('click',function(){
    if(gOpened)return;gOpened=true;gift.classList.add('shake');
    setTimeout(function(){
      gift.classList.remove('shake');gift.classList.add('open');burst(gift,24);
      setTimeout(function(){go('s7')},1900);
    },700);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
